_readme: Yeh file do jagah use hoti hai:
1) gateway/leads.py -> 'selectors' se OpenStreetMap Overpass query banti hai (kaunsi businesses dhoondhni hain)
2) prompts/site-generator.md -> 'brief' AI ko batata hai ke us category ki site me kya hona chahiye
Naya niche add karna ho to ek entry copy-paste karke tag badal dein. Bas.
Overpass selector syntax: nwr = (node/way/relation). 'name' mandatory hai warna无名 leads aa jaate hain.

restaurant.label: Restaurant / Cafe
restaurant.brief: Hero me signature dish + 'Order on WhatsApp' button. Sections: hero, must-try menu (5-8 items with PKR prices), timings + map, gallery, reviews strip, WhatsApp order CTA, footer. Dark/warm palette, food-first imagery, big appetising photos.

salon.label: Beauty Salon / Spa
salon.brief: Elegant, light, feminine/neutral palette (blush, cream, gold accents). Sections: hero with 'Book appointment', services + price list, before/after gallery grid, stylist profiles, booking WhatsApp CTA, timings + map. Soft shadows, rounded cards.

gym.label: Gym / Fitness
gym.brief: Bold high-contrast dark theme, neon accent (lime/orange/red), condensed uppercase headings. Sections: hero with free-trial offer, membership pricing table (3 plans), class timetable, trainers, transformation results, WhatsApp 'Book free trial' CTA.

clinic.label: Clinic / Doctor / Dental
clinic.brief: Trust-first, clean and calm (white + teal/blue), generous spacing, no gimmicks. Sections: hero with 'Book appointment' + timings, doctors list with specialisation, services (with prices if known), patient FAQs, map + directions, WhatsApp appointment CTA. Add a visible 'Walk-ins welcome' note.

realestate.label: Real Estate / Interior
realestate.brief: Premium, magazine-like layout: full-bleed images, serif display font, muted luxury palette (charcoal + gold / deep green). Sections: hero with project name + CTA, featured properties/projects grid with cards (beds/baths/area or sqft), payment plan, location map, agent WhatsApp CTA, enquiry form (mailto fallback).

retail.label: Shop / Retail / Electronics
retail.brief: Catalogue style: product grid with prices, category chips, offers banner, home-delivery note, 'Order / check price on WhatsApp' CTA, shop timings + map. Bright, retail-y palette.

education.label: School / Academy / Tutor
education.brief: Friendly, credible. Sections: hero with admission-open banner, courses/programs with fees, faculty, results/testimonials, campus gallery, fee schedule, admission enquiry on WhatsApp, map + timings.

services.label: Local Service (AC repair / plumber / tailor / etc.)
services.brief: Ultra-practical one-pager: 'Call / WhatsApp now' above the fold, services list with typical price ranges, 3-step how-it-works, service area + timings, reviews, big sticky call button. Trust badges (years of work, visits same day).

hotel.label: Hotel / Guest House
hotel.brief: Calming luxury: full-width room gallery, room types with rates, amenities icon row (wifi, parking, AC, breakfast), location/nearby attractions, 'Book on WhatsApp' CTA, policy/checkout info.
